summary: Implemented the ADR-025 clause 1 administrator-authenticated read-only diagnostics status endpoint (Phase 17 task 17.2, goal F3). src/ArrTags/Diagnostics/ArrTagsStatusController.cs is a public sealed plugin ControllerBase discovered by Jellyfin through ApplicationHost.GetApiPluginAssemblies (no ArrTags-specific registration): [ApiController], class-level [Authorize(Policy = Policies.RequiresElevation)], [Route("ArrTags/Status")], and exactly one action, GET /ArrTags/Status, which resolves the singleton DiagnosticsSnapshotProvider through its single constructor dependency and returns the fixed-shape DiagnosticsSnapshot unchanged. The endpoint is never [AllowAnonymous], adds no write verb, no second route, and no configuration setting, and never mutates configuration, work, or artwork; the ADR-016 clause 6 anonymous static page resource is untouched. tests/ArrTags.Tests/DiagnosticsStatusEndpointTests.cs adds nine cases (eight unconditional, one host-guarded): the controller surface (route, elevation policy, no AllowAnonymous, one [HttpGet] action, no write verb, no action-level route), the read-only dependency surface (one constructor parameter; the provider exposes only GetSnapshot), the action returns the live snapshot and changes no state (counters/queue depth/in-flight identical before and after), the serialized response under the pinned JsonDefaults.Options has exactly the 28 fixed leaf paths with every leaf a number or a declared ArrConnectionHealth name and no array/object/boolean/null carrier, and the real ASP.NET Core MVC pipeline rejects an anonymous request with 401 and an authenticated non-administrator with 403 while an authenticated administrator receives 200 with a body identical to the serialization of the live snapshot. The harness registers the pinned host policy shape (authenticated principal plus the Administrator role claim; UserRoles is host-only so the value is pinned) and disables endpoint routing so MVC's AuthorizeFilter enforces the same [Authorize] metadata the host's AuthorizationMiddleware enforces; the host-guarded fact confirms the endpoint's policy name equals the pinned host Jellyfin.Api.Controllers.PluginsController class-level policy. Eight temporary sensitivity probes were run and reverted (elevation gate removed 3 failures; route prefix drift 1; POST action 1; mutating LibraryWorkQueue dependency 1; mutating provider method 1; anonymous object with an extra string field 3; hardcoded empty snapshot 2; IReadOnlyList<long> array carrier 2). Documentation: changelog Phase 17/task 17.2 entry, PLANS.md checkbox 17.2, state.json task done/report/updated_utc, and the minimal architecture 04 component-table row for the endpoint; render-docs-state up to date and check-docs PASS before the report was persisted. Host-guarded run not performed: ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR is unset in this environment and the new host-guarded fact skips. F3 stays open until 17.4.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A read-only plugin endpoint returns the fixed-shape, bounded, secret-free diagnostics snapshot.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: src/ArrTags/Diagnostics/ArrTagsStatusController.cs is a public sealed plugin ControllerBase with one action, GET ArrTags/Status, returning ActionResult<DiagnosticsSnapshot> from DiagnosticsSnapshotProvider.GetSnapshot(). DiagnosticsStatusEndpointTests.ControllerExposesExactlyOneReadOnlyGetActionAndNoWriteRoute pins the single action/return type, ActionReturnsTheLiveFixedShapeSnapshotAndChangesNoState pins the live nine-field snapshot values, and SerializedSnapshotCarriesExactlyTheFixedCounterPathsAndNoStringArrayOrSecretCarrier pins the serialized shape. Probe F shows the action test fails (2) when the action stops reading the provider.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: It is authorized only for an authenticated administrator via [Authorize(Policy = Policies.RequiresElevation)]; verify the attribute is present and that the endpoint is not anonymous.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ControllerIsAnElevationGatedApiControllerWithOneGetRoute asserts the single class-level AuthorizeAttribute with Policy == Policies.RequiresElevation ('RequiresElevation'), and that no AllowAnonymousAttribute exists at class or action level. AnonymousRequestIsChallengedWithoutASnapshot (401) and AuthenticatedNonAdministratorIsForbidden (403) prove the policy is enforced through the real MVC pipeline, and AuthenticatedAdministratorReceivesTheExactBoundedSnapshot (200) proves the administrator path. Probe A (gate replaced with [AllowAnonymous]) fails those 3 tests. The host-guarded fact EndpointUsesThePinnedHostAdministratorGatingPolicy compares the policy name to the pinned host Jellyfin.Api.Controllers.PluginsController class-level policy; it skips here (ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR unset).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: It adds no write route and never mutates configuration, work, or artwork (assert by inspecting the controller's surface/actions).
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ControllerExposesExactlyOneReadOnlyGetActionAndNoWriteRoute asserts the only declared public method is the [HttpGet] GetStatus action, that no method carries HttpPost/HttpPut/HttpDelete/HttpPatch, and that no method declares a route; ControllerDependsOnlyOnTheReadOnlySnapshotProvider asserts the single constructor parameter is DiagnosticsSnapshotProvider and that the provider exposes only GetSnapshot (no mutation); ActionReturnsTheLiveFixedShapeSnapshotAndChangesNoState asserts the counters, queue depth, and in-flight count are identical before and after the call. Probes C (POST action), D (mutating queue dependency), and G (mutating provider method) each fail these guards (1 failure each).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: It exposes no secret, path, item name, item identifier list, provider payload, credential, or unbounded collection; the response shape is fixed and bounded (assert the serialized/returned shape has exactly the bounded fields and no string/array carrier).
acceptance_criteria.evidence: AssertFixedBoundedResponseShape walks the serialized document and asserts exactly the 28 fixed leaf paths (QueueDepth, QueueInFlight, SonarrHealth, RadarrHealth, MatchingFailures.NotFound/Ambiguous/Unsupported, CacheHits, CacheMisses, StaleMetadataTransitions, and one RenderFailures.<reason> per declared RenderFailureReason), that every leaf is a number or a declared ArrConnectionHealth name (string leaves only at SonarrHealth/RadarrHealth), and that any array/object/boolean/null carrier throws. It is applied to the direct JsonDefaults.Options serialization and to the MVC response body; the administrator pipeline case additionally asserts the body equals the serialization of the live snapshot. Probe H (temporary IReadOnlyList<long> model member) fails with "the non-bounded JSON value kind Array at 'ProbeValues'" (2 failures), and probe E (extra string field in the action response) fails the pipeline shape/equality assertions (3 failures).

interpretations.question: Which route template and response type does the endpoint expose, given ADR-025 clause 1 says 'for example GET /ArrTags/Status' and the task allows returning DiagnosticsSnapshot directly or a thin DTO?
interpretations.chosen: Route prefix 'ArrTags/Status' with the class-level [Route] and a single [HttpGet] action (so the effective route is GET /ArrTags/Status), returning the DiagnosticsSnapshot directly rather than a new DTO.
interpretations.basis: ADR-025 clause 1 fixes the /ArrTags/... convention and names GET /ArrTags/Status as the example; the delegation explicitly permits returning the fixed-shape model directly, and 17.1 already pins that model's bounded/secret-free shape, so a DTO would duplicate the contract.
interpretations.impact: The response property set is the 17.1 contract (nine fields, 28 serialized leaf paths) that the 17.3 panel and the 17.4 review consume; changing it requires a new decision per ADR-025 clause 3.

interpretations.question: How is the elevation gate verified without a live Jellyfin host or the Microsoft.AspNetCore.TestHost package (no new dependency allowed)?
interpretations.chosen: An in-process MVC harness invokes the real controller action through IActionInvokerFactory with the same policy shape the pinned host defines (authenticated principal + Administrator role claim), and disables endpoint routing so MVC's AuthorizeFilter enforces the [Authorize] metadata; the host's policy identity is additionally pinned by the [JellyfinHostFact] policy-name comparison and by the existing research section 9.3.
interpretations.basis: The host uses endpoint routing and enforces [Authorize] via AuthorizationMiddleware, which is not reachable from a direct invoker harness without a TestServer package; MVC's AuthorizeFilter evaluates the same metadata against the same IAuthorizationService/policy, and the harness documents the substitution.
interpretations.impact: The in-process 401/403/200 results prove the attribute and policy shape are enforced by the MVC filter pipeline, not the host middleware; the exact host policy definition (AddJellyfinApiAuthorization -> RequireClaim(ClaimTypes.Role, UserRoles.Administrator)) remains pinned by research and the host-guarded fact rather than executed here.

known_limitations: No host-guarded run was performed: ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR is unset in this environment, so EndpointUsesThePinnedHostAdministratorGatingPolicy reports [SKIP] and the pinned host's discovery of the controller (ApplicationHost.GetApiPluginAssemblies), its AuthorizationMiddleware enforcement of the endpoint, and the live 401/403/200 behavior are not exercised here. Precondition - the variable is unset. Behaviour - the fact skips and the default suite reports 64 skips (63 pre-existing + this one). Consequence - host-side route discovery and authorization of the endpoint remain unverified until a pinned host run is available (the task 17.4 review and the release live matrix are the places that can carry it).

The in-process authorization harness does not boot Jellyfin's AddJellyfinApiAuthorization or its AuthorizationMiddleware: it registers a policy with the pinned host shape (authenticated principal + Administrator role claim) and disables endpoint routing so MVC's AuthorizeFilter enforces the [Authorize] metadata. Precondition - a direct IActionInvokerFactory harness with no middleware pipeline and no Microsoft.AspNetCore.TestHost package (no new dependency allowed). Behaviour - the 401/403/200 results come from MVC's filter path, and the exact host policy definition is pinned by research section 9.3 and the host-guarded policy-name comparison rather than executed. Consequence - a future host change to the RequiresElevation policy definition would not be caught by the in-process facts; it would be caught by the host-guarded fact only if the policy name changed.

The endpoint's JSON property names and enum form depend on the host's MVC JSON options (the pinned JsonDefaults.Options shape: PascalCase names, string enums), which the direct serialization test uses and the pipeline harness mirrors with its own options. Precondition - the host configures MVC JSON options as the pinned revision does. Behaviour - the response shape is the fixed property set with enum names; a host option change (for example camelCase or numeric enums) would change the serialized spelling, not the field set. Consequence - the 17.3 panel must consume the shape tolerantly; the field set and boundedness are pinned by the shape test regardless of naming.

The read-only panel, the endpoint security review, and the F3 resolution are deliberately absent: ADR-025 clauses 2 and 6 and the F3 limitation closure belong to tasks 17.3 and 17.4. F3 stays Open in docs/limitations/open.md and the architecture 12 open-limitation paragraph stays accurate until 17.4.
The panel's consumption of the endpoint (including the fail-closed no-data behavior when the endpoint is unauthorized) is untested here because the panel is task 17.3.
